title: Unit pricing: Guide to good practice
subject: This guide addresses good practice in unit pricing for investment life insurance policies, superannuation funds, and managed investment schemes. It provides guidance on the design, implementation, and review of unit pricing processes to ensure accuracy and fairness for members and investors.
background: The guide is a joint publication by ASIC and APRA, following a review of unit pricing practices from July to December 2004. It is intended for product providers such as life companies, superannuation trustees, and responsible entities, as well as service providers who perform outsourced unit pricing functions. The legislative context includes obligations under the Corporations Act 2001 and the Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Act 1993.
ruling: ASIC and APRA expect product providers to have robust unit pricing policies and procedures that ensure unit prices are calculated accurately and consistently. The regulators emphasize that unit pricing errors should be identified promptly and rectified in a fair and transparent manner, including compensating affected members where appropriate. The guide outlines key principles such as the use of appropriate valuation methodologies, timely processing of transactions, and maintaining clear audit trails. ASIC and APRA also expect senior management to take responsibility for unit pricing governance and to regularly review compliance with this guidance.
